periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis of both patches is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle downward toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval-teardrop morphology with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.8:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering, with the inferior margin extending notably further from the geometric center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow, broadly curved U-shape across the posterior margin of the interscapular region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band exhibits high relative thickness, covering the entire shoulder girdle and extending down to the elbow joint.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Large inter-pinna gap, approximately twice the individual width of the ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Consistent semicircular convex curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, distinct orange-colored object held near the oral cavity, contrasting with the standard black and white pelage.
